summary.text: STIFTELSEN NORDLANDSJEKTA "BRØDRENE" is a foundation registered in Melbu, founded 1992-07-27. It was previously named STIFT. NORDLANDSJEKTA "BRØDRENE" V/ASBJ. HERTEIG until 1997-05-15. Its registered activity: "Stiftelsen har til formål å bygge en tilnærmet tro kopi av Nordlansjekta "Brødrene" av Solum/Melbu og gjennom vedlikehold, utstyr og bruk av den a) å initiere og drive forskning om jektebygging, jekte" Its main industry code is 77.340: rental and leasing of water transport equipment. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 584 492 NOK and the annual result was 10 774 NOK; operating income was up from 532 235 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -89 901 NOK in 2024 to 10 774 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 72 759 NOK in 2024 to 83 533 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is nordlandsjekta.no, which links to its Facebook profile. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-25 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
